product.ta-alphatronic-p40.summary: The P40 combined fixed storage with the 8- and 16-bit Alphatronic line.
product.ta-alphatronic-p40.history: Triumph-Adler showed the P40 alongside the P30 in Hanover in 1984. Within that office line, the P40 shared the 12.5 MB hard disk option with the P4.
product.ta-alphatronic-p40.technical.con: An optional graphics controller extended the display capabilities. The 1984 announcement specified 640 × 288 and eight shades of grey or eight RGB colours. The French Science & Vie Micro review described a configuration without a graphics mode.
product.ta-alphatronic-p40.technical.ver: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p40.technical.lim: The model-specific firmware and a boot disk remain to be preserved for verification.
